title: Asset meta
description: The meta.json of a Clip or a Sequence (same shape). Frame pixel size is never stored here: it is the Character's Canvas. See docs/format-spec.md.

id.description: Asset id; must equal the folder name.

frameCount.description: Number of frames; the sheet is frameCount frames laid out left to right.

delaysMs.description: Per-frame duration in ms. Either one value (uniform) or exactly frameCount values. See docs/format-spec.md.
